title: OrderCancelledPayload
description: Payload of the order.cancelled event (routing key order.cancelled), wrapped in envelope.v1.json. Published by Ordering when the saga ended without a settled payment. A fact for observers and read models: no context consumes it yet.

reason.description: Which saga step ended the order: stock_unavailable after inventory.reservation_failed, payment_failed after payment.failed. Adding a value is a breaking change (new schema version).
